{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/index/base.cpp and index implementations to parallelize initial index sync.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "Parallelizing block digestion dramatically speeds up initial index synchronization for block filters. Benchmarks cited by the author showed block filter index generation dropping from over 7 hours to under 1 hour with 4 workers, and Sjors confirmed a drop from 35m down to 4m26s with 32 workers. Although txindex exhibited minor write contention slowdowns on SSDs, drastically accelerating filter builds provides substantial, durable performance value for index users."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "src/test/fuzz/threadpool.cpp and src/test/threadpool_tests.cpp test the new utility rather than modifying general test infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The included test and fuzz files specifically test the new thread pool and index logic rather than framework-level test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Introduces a general-purpose ThreadPool utility in src/util/threadpool.h.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "The PR adds a generic ThreadPool utility intended for concurrent task execution across node components. Reviewers recognized its potential for broader reuse, though concerns over synchronization complexity and deadlocks indicate it serves primarily as a worthwhile building block rather than solving an urgent utility deficiency."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "The PR touches optional indexes under src/index/ rather than consensus or chainstate code, despite the 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "The changes affect only optional secondary indexes and utilities, leaving core validation, block storage, and chainstate untouched."
    }
  ],
